backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing booking and review management with storage mixin, including functions to add/approve/delete reviews, add bookings, and query reviews by service/rating/approval status.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: service category card image replacement, global background gradient theme, and mobile dropdown scrolling fixes for Booking and Reviews pages.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components and pages including routing, layout, navigation, service displays, booking forms, reviews, and UI components with their specific features and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, and component styling using HSL color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with meta tags for viewport, cache control, and a root div for React mounting with module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: React application root using TanStack Router to configure six routes (Home, Services, Pricing, Booking, Contact, Reviews) with Layout wrapper and smooth scroll-to-top functionality.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedReviewsC: Carousel component displaying up to 6 approved reviews with glass-morphism cards, star ratings, avatars, loading skeletons, and navigation arrows using shadcn/ui Carousel.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed floating WhatsApp button in bottom-right corner with official green color (#25D366), pulse animation, notification badge, and link to wa.me/918884447229.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying company info, contact details (phone, email, address), quick navigation links, social media icons, and a service availability banner. Includes WhatsApp integration and payment method icons.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section component with full-width background image, gradient overlay, and centered call-to-action featuring the TrustFix branding and a 'Book Now' button linking to the booking page.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that structures the app with a watermarked background, navbar, main content area, footer, and floating WhatsApp button.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile menus, search functionality with live results dropdown, and responsive design that changes appearance on scroll.
frontend/src/components/PricingCard.tsx: Card component displaying individual service pricing information including name, category, description, starting price, and a 'Book Service' button.
frontend/src/components/ReviewCard.tsx: Card component for displaying customer reviews with avatar, name, service, star rating, review text, and submission date.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Card component for displaying service offerings with image, category badge, name, description, starting price, and 'Book Now' button with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCategoryG: Grid layout component displaying eight service categories (Pest Control, Carpentry, Cleaning, etc.) as clickable cards with images, icons, and scroll-triggered animations.
frontend/src/components/StarRating.tsx: Reusable star rating component supporting both interactive and read-only modes, displaying 1-5 stars with optional click handlers for rating selection.
frontend/src/components/SuccessPopup.tsx: Modal popup component displaying success messages with a checkmark icon, auto-dismissing after 5 seconds, and manual close button.
React form component for submitting customer reviews with fields for name, service selection, star rating, review text, and optional photo upload. Uses useReviewSubmission hook and displays a success popup on submission.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Static data export containing service categories (Pest Control, Carpentry, Cleaning, Electrical, AC Services) with service details including name, description, price, and image paths.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
Hook for submitting booking requests to the backend actor and opening WhatsApp with prefilled booking details. Manages submission state and success status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY AuthClient, managing login state, identity persistence, and authentication lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching approved reviews across all service types and retrieving all bookings from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useReviewSubmission.t: Hook for submitting customer reviews to the backend actor with optional photo upload as ExternalBlob, invalidating the reviews query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchServices.ts: Debounced search hook that filters services from servicesData based on query string matching against service name, category, or description.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with TrustFix brand colors (green and orange) in OKLCH format for light/dark modes, glassmorphism utilities, and custom animations including fade-in, slide-up, and wave-in effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx: Booking form page that allows users to submit service requests with name, phone, email, service selection, address, and message fields; includes success popup and pre-fills service from URL params.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying company contact information (phone, email, location), WhatsApp link, embedded Google Maps, and a contact form with basic alert-based submission.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page featuring hero section, service category grid, and customer reviews carousel with intersection observer for scroll animations.
frontend/src/pages/Pricing.tsx: Pricing page displaying all services organized by category with pricing cards and a disclaimer that final prices depend on inspection.
frontend/src/pages/Reviews.tsx: Reviews page showing approved customer reviews with filtering by service category, average rating display, and a form to write new reviews.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: Services page displaying all available services in a tabbed interface with category filtering and support for pre-selected category via URL params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom colors (including trustfix-green/orange), shadows (glass effects), animations, and theme extensions using OKLCH color space.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking TrustFix Home Services web application with React/TypeScript frontend, Motoko backend, 6 pages (Home, Services, Pricing, Booking, Contact, Reviews), glassmorphism design, customer review approval workflow, WhatsApp booking integration, and search functionality. Contains architectural notes, existing features, image requirements for 8 service categories, and contact details (phone: 8884447229, email: htrustfix@gmail.com, Bangalore address).
